1073742825:
Usage: analyze [analyzer ...] [options]

  Run one or more analyzers to display current update status.
  If no analyzer is specified, all analyzers are run.

Options:
  --out <file>     Write output to specified file
  --list           List available analyzers
  --help           Display this help

Output format overrides:
  --console        Force console formatted output
  --json           Force JSON output
  --html           Force HTML output
  --tree           Force tree output

  Without --out or a format override, HTML is written to a temp file,
  the path is printed, and the report is opened in your default browser.

  With --out and without a format override, the format is determined by file extension:
    .json          Raw JSON output
    .html/.htm     HTML formatted output
    other          Console formatted output

Advanced:
  --temp <dir>     Temp directory for analysis data storage
  --offline <dir>  Run in offline mode against an expanded data bundle
  --params <args>  Additional parameters passed to analyzers

Feedback (requires exactly one analyzer):
  --feedback <text>  Free-text feedback comment
  --rating <1-5>     Star rating
